title: timeline export native yuv seam

commit.merge_subject: merge: timeline export native yuv seam

description:
The timeline walk (TimelineMp4Exporter) converted each frame with a
direct YuvConverter.toI420 call in Kotlin, bypassing the NativeRgbToI420
seam the per-clip ExportPipeline already routes through. On device that
left the single biggest per-frame cost on the JVM: the per-clip path's
measurement attributed ~375 ms/frame to this conversion (owner request
2026-11-13, 709-frame timeline export measured at ~14 minutes).

Route the walk's conversion through the SAME seam, not a copy:
- constructor param converter: RgbToI420 = NativeRgbToI420 (mirrors
  ExportPipeline's shape; the app's named-arg wiring is unchanged, JVM
  tests inject a fake);
- the frame loop calls convertFrame(), which dispatches through the
  seam and feeds the writer traced.i420;
- convertFrame() carries the per-clip path's debug dual-run: the FIRST
  native frame per export is also converted by Kotlin and the byte
  compa
changed: fix: timeline export uses native yuv converter
